headline: Pakistan Reserves $1.08 Billion Export Financing Target for SME Exporters
summary: The Pakistani government allocated Rs300 billion ($1.08 billion) under the Pak EXIM Export Finance Scheme exclusively for eligible SME exporters, supporting a target to expand total SME credit to Rs2 trillion.
why: SME financing support programs directly affect export competitiveness and credit growth in Pakistan's manufacturing sectors.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Earmarking concessional credit for SMEs aims to boost Pakistani manufactured exports.
